decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that Chainlink VRF selects winners on-chain with results verifiable on Basescan, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The VRF decision changes the separate winner-selection Requirement, while the Big Block prize parameters, funding, eligibility window, and ticket reset rules remain unchanged.
The VRF decision changes the separate winner-selection Requirement, while the Small Block prize parameters, funding, eligibility window, and ticket reset rules remain unchanged.
Selecting winners through Chainlink VRF does not change the requirement to announce winners on the Winners page.
The winner-selection provider and verifiability do not change the existing one-click manual claim flow on the Winners page.
The Chainlink VRF selection decision does not alter the NFT mint number's role as a permanent referral code or its display and resale behavior.
On-chain VRF winner selection does not change badge milestones, award conditions, or on-chain badge recording.
The randomness provider for prize draws is unrelated to the Transak fiat-to-USDC mint flow and supported payment methods.
The VRF winner-selection decision does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limit.
Using Chainlink VRF to select prize winners does not alter the mint price or allocation of primary-sale revenue.
The winner-selection mechanism does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state transfer on resale.
On-chain and Basescan-verifiable winner selection does not entail any change to the metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attribute currently required.
